tasks.label: Check remote Supabase migrations (dry run only)
args: const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const specs=[['MIGRATION LIST',['--yes','supabase@latest','migration','list','--remote','gycjliqtcstomzegfcbz']],['DB PUSH DRY RUN',['--yes','supabase@latest','db','push','--dry-run','--remote','gycjliqtcstomzegfcbz']]]; for (const [label,args] of specs) { const r=spawnSync('npx',args,{encoding:'utf8',shell:true}); let s=((r.stdout||'')+(r.stderr||'')); s=s.replace(/sbp_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g,'[REDACTED_TOKEN]').replace(/eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g,'[REDACTED_JWT]').replace(/(SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN|access_token|password|secret)(\s*[=:]\s*)\S+/gi,'$1$2[REDACTED]'); console.log('=== '+label+' ==='); console.log(s.trimEnd()); console.log('EXIT_CODE='+(r.status===null?'null':r.status)); if(r.error) console.log('SPAWN_ERROR='+String(r.error)); }
